title: Normalized quotient models and invertible recursive substitutions
statement: Let $\ell$ be prime, $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$ a finite extension, and $Z\xrightarrow{h}X\xrightarrow{f}Y$ scheme morphisms with $\ell$ invertible at every point. Use the expression syntax, good-complex category, fixed quotient construction and recursive substitutions of [def-pur-completed-comparison-quotient-realization-data], together with the fixed completed operations of [def-weil-derived-pullback-tensor-hom]. Given three constructible inputs $M_i$, prescribed flat-term K-flat good representatives $P_i$ and isomorphisms $Q(P_i)\cong M_i$, every strict expression in their actual quotient systems is good at each finite level and is a normalized coefficient sequence. There exist proofs of goodness and invertibility for every recursive substitution from the specified completed expression to the total limit of that strict expression; the prescribed counit reduction of each substitution is invertible. Each input quotient has the fixed finite-level coefficient reduction presentation. This is precisely the model and invertibility part of completed quotient normalization, with its already-proved construction; the separate naturality assertion is not included.

source.place: Compatibility with finite reduction and extension of scalars; agent refinement of lem-pur-completed-comparison-quotient-realization, Normalized quotient expressions and recursive substitution. Stacks 07A2, 0G7E, 07A4 and 0941.

proof.text: For each prescribed good representative apply lem-pur-completed-quotient-reduction-presentation to its actual ordinary quotient complex and the fixed comparison/evaluation isomorphisms. Its evaluation isomorphisms transport finite K-flatness and flat terms; levelwiseFlatModels gives SystemGood. The unit, tensor and pullback preservation lemmas of lem-pur-quotient-expression-strict-kflat-towers give GoodExpressions and finite Good by induction. Apply quotientExpressionKFlatOperations to these exact input complexes, their presentation transitions and Generated constructor proofs, obtaining normalization of every strictValue expression.

Convert intrinsic constructible completeness to unrestricted completeness via lem-sf-derived-complete-legacy-comparison, choosing an auxiliary finite-field characteristic different from l. Unrestricted normalized reconstruction inverts the actual leaf unit and the actual counit on every normalized expression. Recursive induction proves invertibility of substituteInputs: the units are identities; tensors and pullbacks are composites of the fixed primitive realization, functorial images of the two invertible coherent reductions, and the fixed K-flat or exact-pullback isomorphism. Hence substitution and its specified counit reduction are invertible.

theorem completedComparisonQuotientModels
    {Z X Y : Scheme.{u}} (h : Z ⟶ X) (f : X ⟶ Y)
    [∀ z : Z, Invertible (l : Z.residueField z)]
    [∀ x : X, Invertible (l : X.residueField x)]
    [∀ y : Y, Invertible (l : Y.residueField y)]
    (M : Fin 3 → sfIntegralConstructibleCategory l E Y)
    (P : Fin 3 → (integralOperationsGoodComplex l E Y).FullSubcategory)
    (φ : ∀ i : Fin 3, DerivedCategory.Q.obj (P i).obj ≅ (M i).obj)
    :
    ∃ (good : GoodExpressions l E h f P)
      (_invertible : ∀ {W : Scheme.{u}} (A : StrictQuotient.Expression h f 3 W),
        IsIso (substitution l E P (fun i ↦ (M i).obj) φ good A)),
    (∀ {W : Scheme.{u}} (A : StrictQuotient.Expression h f 3 W),
      (∀ n : ℕ, StrictQuotient.Good l E
        (strictValue l E (fun i ↦ quotient l E (P i).obj) A) n) ∧
      IsNormalizedCoefficientSequence l E W
        (DerivedCategory.Q.obj (strictValue l E (fun i ↦ quotient l E (P i).obj) A)) ∧
      IsIso (reduction l E (substitution l E P (fun i ↦ (M i).obj) φ good A))) ∧
    (∀ i : Fin 3, CoefficientReductionPresentation l E Y
      (pullbackTensorCalculus l E Y).toCoefficientDerivedSystemReduction
      (P i).obj (P i).property.1 (quotient l E (P i).obj)
      ((pullbackTensorReductionModel l E Y).app (P i))
      (fun n ↦ ((pullbackTensorReductionEvaluationComplex l E Y n).app (P i).obj).symm))
